scope: Typed TS adapter and relocatable local development package consuming existing Rust playback in actual Node Workers. No complete presentation/browser/Office-WPS/product replacement or release performance claim.

boundary.core: Existing Rust validation, timeline, page compilation and raster semantics unchanged.
boundary.sdk: Explicit typed owner, response correlation, no extra pixel copy, deterministic WASM handle release, reentry guard.
boundary.product: Worker scheduling/termination, clocks/events/display/media, authorized input and persistent results.
boundary.realComponentInvalidation: Terminate the host Worker. Core plan survival after an invalid external reply does not override the real component isolation policy.

package.sizeScope: Unminified local development bundle, existing partial profiles. No desktop size prediction or full future-capability size claim.

nativeWasmSdkComparison.scope: Compared current WASM SDK output with preserved actual Native SDK artifacts, including complete metadata and pixel bytes. Native sampler was not re-executed in this stage; Rust/core sources unchanged.

observations.scope: Actual Node Worker and WASM; no browser or full PPT claim.

types.publicEs2022: passed without skipLibCheck or raw binding import
types.rawWasmBinding: passed structural compatibility with its required ESNext.Disposable declarations

verification.overlap: The 13 TS tests and 3 package tests are included in the 15 gates. Legacy operation-client regression is not new playback functionality.

preservedFailure.reason: Public declarations unnecessarily imported all raw wasm-bindgen types with Symbol.dispose. Removed that coupling and separately verified ES2022 facade and raw bindings with the correct standard library; generated declarations were not rewritten.

notRerun: Full Rust tests, MCP protocol/client installation and native export cases: implementations and dependency locks unchanged. Strict workspace Clippy and current document Native/WASM parity executed.
C++ sanitizers, Office/WPS, browser Web Workers and product flows: separate acceptance requirements; this stage does not claim them.
pending: Full high-level creation/import/edit/render/export APIs across integration targets.
Complete effects/transitions/Morph/media/SmartArt/math and all committed presentation capabilities.
Browser and platform runtime acceptance, real fonts/corpus and Office/WPS editing roundtrip.
Musterwork Artifact/Viewer/Player/history migration and full replacement gates.
